articles.headline: Qualcomm, Impinj, Power Integrations, and Kulicke and Soffa shares are soaring, what you need to know
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Qualcomm, Impinj, Power Integrations, and Kulicke and Soffa shares jumped in the morning session after dip-buyers entered beaten-down semiconductor and hardware names following a steep market rout. The turnaround was aided by President Donald Trump expressing 100% support for AI infrastructure on Truth Social, describing data centers as gold and pledging capacity expansion help, which eased concerns caused by Democratic midterm victories and calls for data-center halts. In separate industry news, Reuters reported that Micron paused work on a planned $4.5 billion memory-chip plant in Taiwan due to an extended labor dispute, adding uncertainty to capacity expansion.
articles.summary_zh: 高通、Impinj、Power Integrations以及Kulicke and Soffa的股价在早盘交易中上涨，此前由于半导体和硬件板块经历19个月来最大单日跌幅，逢低买入者涌入这些被打压的股票。 市场回暖得益于美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在Truth Social上发文称其100%支持人工智能基础设施，将数据中心称为黄金并承诺协助各州扩大产能，从而缓解了民主党中期选举胜利及暂停数据中心项目呼吁所引发的担忧。 此外，据路透社报道，美光科技因长期劳资纠纷已暂停在台湾建设一座计划投资$4.5 billion的存储芯片工厂，这给其产能扩张增添了不确定性。

articles.headline: Nvidia Plunges 4% but New York Stocks Rally Anyway — Nasdaq Jumps 2.7% in Rare Move Not Seen in 17 Years
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: New York stocks rebounded sharply on the 9th as bargain-hunting emerged after an AI share selloff and international crude prices dropped. The Nasdaq Composite rose 2.74% to 25,253.14, the S&P 500 gained 2.35% to 7,549.94, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 2.15% to 52,389.75. Semiconductor stocks surged, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 6.85%. Nvidia bucked the trend, plunging 4.27% to $178.67 and losing about $192.1 billion in market value in a single day amid controversy involving CEO Jensen Huang, including an independent board investigation and an acknowledged extramarital relationship. Nvidia has fallen 11.6% over the past week, erasing $564 billion in market capitalization. Wall Street analysts from Morgan Stanley, UBS, Infrastructure Capital Advisors, and Cantor Fitzgerald viewed the selloff as excessive, arguing long-term AI infrastructure and data center construction will continue.
articles.summary_zh: 纽约股市在9日全面强劲反弹，受人工智能股票抛售潮后涌现的抄底买盘以及国际原油价格大幅下跌的推动。 纳斯达克综合指数上涨2.74%至25,253.14点，标普500指数上涨2.35%至7,549.94点，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨2.15%至52,389.75点。 半导体股票集体飙升，费城半导体指数大涨6.85%。 与此相反，英伟达逆势大跌4.27%收于$178.67，单日市值蒸发约$192.1 billion，其CEO黄仁勋卷入董事会独立调查及承认婚外情等争议中。 英伟达在过去一周下跌了11.6%，市值缩水$564 billion。 来自摩根士丹利、瑞银、基础设施资本顾问公司和坎托·菲茨杰拉德等华尔街分析师认为此轮抛售过度，并辩称长期的人工智能基础设施与数据中心建设仍将继续推进。

articles.headline: GOOGL Stock: Should You Buy the Best-Performing Magnificent Seven Stock Right Now?
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) is positioned as a balanced investment within the Magnificent Seven, driven by its AI strategy, cloud revenue growth, and strong advertising performance. The company generates massive cash flow to internally fund AI infrastructure and innovations, shifting investor perception from an AI laggard to an integrated AI leader. Key revenue sources include Search, YouTube monetization and subscriptions, and Google Cloud enterprise AI technology. However, risks include competitive disruption in search economics, regulatory scrutiny regarding digital advertising and search dominance, and high expectations associated with its top-performing stock status.
articles.summary_zh: Alphabet（GOOGL）被定位为“七巨头”中的平衡投资，依托其人工智能战略、云业务收入增长以及强劲的广告表现。 该公司产生巨额现金流以内部资助人工智能基础设施和创新，转变了投资者将其视为人工智能落后者的看法，使其成为一体化的人工智能企业。 其核心收入来源包括搜索业务、YouTube视频变现与订阅服务以及谷歌云企业人工智能技术。 然而，面临的风险包括搜索经济模式受到竞争颠覆、监管机构对数字广告及搜索主导地位的审查，以及作为顶级表现股票所承载的高市场预期。

articles.headline: Tesla Soars 5% as Robotaxi Reaches San Antonio and Cybertruck Order Rate “Far Exceeds” Production
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Tesla shares rose 5% as its robotaxi service expanded to San Antonio, making it the seventh robotaxi city, while Elon Musk stated that Cybertruck order rates far exceed production rates and deposits will need to be refunded. Musk announced plans to wind down Cybertruck production around mid-2027 to reallocate capacity toward Cybercabs. The robotaxi fleet sizes remain small compared to competitors like Uber, which handled 4.1 billion trips in the third quarter. Tesla's operating margin fell from 16.8% in 2022 to 2.6% in the third quarter of 2026, and the stock traded at 168x forward earnings.
articles.summary_zh: 特斯拉股价上涨5%，其自动驾驶出租车服务已扩展至圣安东尼奥，成为第七个开通该服务的城市，同时埃隆·马斯克表示赛博卡车的订单量远超生产量，并将不得不退还部分定金。 马斯克宣布计划在2027年中期左右逐步停止赛博卡车生产，以为生产更多Cybercab腾出空间。 与在第三季度处理了41亿次行程的优步等竞争对手相比，特斯拉的自动驾驶出租车车队规模依然很小。 特斯拉的营业利润率从2022年的16.8%下降至2026年第三季度的2.6%，其远期市盈率达到168倍。

articles.headline: AI Stock Rout Called 'Unwarranted.' Why Wall Street Sees Post-Midterms Edge For Cloud Giants.
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Wall Street analysts described the post-midterm tumble for technology and artificial intelligence stocks as overdone, noting that a stricter regulatory environment could benefit cloud hyperscale giants Amazon, Microsoft, and Google. Morgan Stanley analysts informed clients that AI-related capital expenditures are expected to remain consistent with pre-election levels, though some data center spending schedules may shift.
articles.summary_zh: 华尔街分析师称中期选举后科技与人工智能股票的下跌被过分夸大，并指出更严格的监管环境可能会使亚马逊、微软和谷歌等云巨头受益。 摩根士丹利分析师向客户表示，预计与人工智能相关的资本支出将保持在选举前的水平，尽管部分数据中心的支出时间表可能会发生调整。

articles.headline: US stock market stages massive rally today, adds $1.5 trillion: 5 reasons why Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasda
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: On Monday, US stock markets rallied as the Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq recovered from recent losses. Advanced Micro Devices jumped 12% driven by a chip stock rebound and an Oppenheimer upgrade to Outperform with a $600 price target. Tesla rose 5.45% to $377.74. Conversely, Nvidia fell 4.98% to $177.34 following an independent board investigation into CEO Jensen Huang regarding an extramarital relationship with Alice Huang, a Singapore-based executive suspected of gathering information for China; Nvidia stated national security and business secrets were not compromised. Broadcom and Marvell gained over 8%, while Constellation Energy and Barrick Mining rose on quarterly results. WTI crude oil fell approximately 3.2% to $87.90 per barrel amid potential easing of tensions in the Iran war, while gold rose 1.5% to about $4,140 an ounce. Bitcoin traded near $75,000, and the 10-year US Treasury yield rose to about 4.89%. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq had experienced four consecutive weekly losses.
articles.summary_zh: 周一美国股市上涨，道琼斯指数、标普500指数和纳斯达克指数从先前的跌势中反弹。 Advanced Micro Devices股价跳涨12%，主要受芯片股回升以及奥本海默将其评级上调至“跑赢大盘”并设定600美元目标价的推动。 特斯拉股价上涨5.45%至377.74美元。 相比之下，由于董事会针对首席执行官黄仁勋展开独立调查，Nvidia股价下跌4.98%至177.34美元，调查起因于其承认与涉嫌为中国搜集情报的新加坡籍商界高管爱丽丝·黄存在婚外情；Nvidia表示没有理由相信国家安全或商业机密受到损害。 Broadcom和Marvell均上涨超过8%，Constellation Energy和Barrick Mining则因季度财报表现走高。 在伊朗战争紧张局势可能缓和的背景下，WTI原油期货下跌约3.2%至每桶87.90.10美元，黄金则上涨1.5%至每盎司约4,140美元。 比特币在75,000美元附近交易，10年期美国国债收益率升至约4.89%。 标普500指数和纳斯达克指数此前曾连续四周下跌。

articles.headline: Stock Indexes Sharply Higher as Tech Stocks Rally and Crude Oil Falls
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: US stock indexes rallied sharply, with the S&P 500 up 2.16%, the Dow Jones up 1.79%, and the Nasdaq 100 up 3.28%, driven by dip buyers targeting beaten-down chipmakers, AI-infrastructure stocks, and Magnificent Seven companies. Sentiment was also supported by a drop in WTI crude oil of more than 3% as diplomatic efforts regarding Iran continued. Nvidia fell over 5% following a board investigation into CEO Huang over an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee made hawkish comments about employment, growth, and rising services inflation. September wholesale trade sales rose 2.8% month-on-month, exceeding the 1.1% expectation. President Trump stated it is highly unlikely he will order more strikes against Iran if peace talks progress, and Israel Hayom reported Iran dropped its demand to control the Strait of Hormuz. Secretary of State Rubio downplayed a breakthrough, noting Iran's demands are unacceptable, and the US launched overnight attacks on Qeshm. Q3 S&P 500 earnings are expected to climb 31% year-on-year according to Bloomberg Intelligence, with 440 companies reporting and 84% beating estimates. The 10-year T-note yield rose 1.4 basis points to 4.872%, and the Treasury announced plans to auction $125 billion of T-notes and T-bonds.
articles.summary_zh: 美国股市主要指数大幅攀升，标普500指数上涨2.16%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨1.79%，纳斯达克100指数上涨3.28%，主要受到抄底买盘涌入近期遭抛售的芯片制造商、AI基础设施股票及“七巨头”科技股的推动。 随着针对伊朗的外交努力持续推进以及WTI原油价格下跌超过3%，市场情绪也得到了提振。 在公司董事会针对首席执行官黄仁勋与一名被怀疑是中国间谍的女性之间的绯闻展开调查后，Nvidia股价下跌超过5%。 芝加哥联储主席 Austan Goolsbee 就就业、经济增长以及服务业通胀回升发表了鹰派言论。 美国9月批发贸易销售额环比增长2.8%，高于1.1%的预期，创下四个月来最大增幅。 特朗普总统表示，如果和平谈判取得进展，他极不可能下令对伊朗进行更多打击，《以色列今日报》报道称伊朗放弃了控制霍尔木兹海峡的要求。 国务卿鲁比奥淡化了取得突破的可能性，称伊朗目前的诉求不可接受，同时美军对格什姆岛发动了夜间空袭。 根据彭博情报汇编的数据，第三季度标普500指数盈利预计将较上年同期增长31%，在已公布财报的440家标普500公司中，有84%超出了预期。 10年期国债收益率上涨1.4个基点至4.872%，美国财政部宣布本周将进行1250亿美元的季度再融资国债拍卖。

articles.headline: 東証後場寄り 日経平均は上昇一服 先物売りが重荷
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: In the morning session of December 10, the Tokyo stock market saw the Nikkei Stock Average pause its advance, trading around the 60,000 yen level, up approximately 1,100 yen from the previous day, after briefly dipping below 60,000 yen. While buying entered high-priced AI and semiconductor-related stocks, selling pressure from overseas short-term speculators on stock index futures narrowed the Nikkei's gains. Basket trading, in which domestic and international large institutional investors trade multiple stocks together, amounted to approximately 300 million yen off-floor at the midday close. As of 12:45 PM, estimated trading value on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market was 4.7751 trillion yen, with a trading volume of 1.49527 billion shares. Lasertec, Kyocera, and Toyota Tsusho advanced, while Sony Group, Toyota, and Terumo declined.
articles.summary_zh: 10日后场开盘的东京股市中，日经平均株価的涨势暂歇，围绕比前一天高出约1100日元的6万日元上下波动，盘中曾一度跌破6万日元。 虽然高价AI及半导体相关股票受到买盘支撑，但来自海外短期投机客对股指期货的卖压增强，导致日经平均指数的涨幅收窄。 午盘收盘后，东交所场外进行的国内外大型机构投资者集中买卖多只股票的“一篮子交易”成交额约为3亿日元。 截至12点45分，东证Prime市场的估算成交额为4.7751万亿日元，成交量为14.9527亿万股。 Lasertec、京瓷和丰田通商上涨，而索尼集团、丰田和泰尔茂下跌。

articles.headline: 日経平均午前1700円高、「トランプ発言」後押し 非鉄株高が映す楽観
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: On December 10, the Nikkei Stock Average continued to rise in the Tokyo stock market, with the morning closing price up 1,700.28 yen, or 2.89%, at 60,475.78 yen. Following the previous day's US stock gains, intermittent buying of Nikkei futures by overseas speculative investors pushed the market upward. US President Trump's remarks denying any re-attack on Iran also spurred Japanese stock purchases. Non-ferrous metal stocks posted notable gains, reflecting optimism regarding data center regulations that had been heightened following the Democratic victory in the US mid-term elections.
articles.summary_zh: 10日的东京股市中，日经平均株価继续上涨，早盘收盘较前一日上涨1700.28日元（2.89%），报60475.78日元。 受9日美股上涨推动，海外投机资金对日经平均期货的持续买盘推高了行情。 美国总统特朗普关于否定对伊朗再次发动攻击的发言，也进一步刺激了日本股票的买盘。 在各行业板块中，“非铁金属股”的上涨引人注目，反映出美国中期选举民主党获胜后曾一度增强的数据中心监管论调带来的乐观情绪。

articles.headline: 【アナリスト評価】シャープ、レーティング弱気を継続、目標株価470円に引下げ（米系大手証券）(アイフィス株予報)
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: A major US-affiliated securities firm maintained its bearish rating of Underperform for Sharp on November 9, while lowering its target price from 500 yen to 470 yen. As of November 6, the rating consensus stood at 1.67, categorized as somewhat bearish by six analysts, with a consensus target price of 512 yen.
articles.summary_zh: 某美系大型证券公司于11月9日维持夏普的“弱势”（3/卖出）评级不变，同时将目标股价从500日元下调至470日元。 截至前一日（11月6日），该股的评级共识为1.67（分析师6人），处于“偏向弱势”水平，目标股价共识为512日元（分析师6人）。

articles.headline: ソフトバンクG株価一時14.9%高 アーム株高やアンソロピック上場観測
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: ソフトバンクグループ（SBG）の株価は11時5分時点で前日比507円（14.91%）高の3907円まで急反発した。 前日の米株式市場で主要半導体関連銘柄で構成するフィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）が7%近く上昇したことや、傘下企業に関する動向が背景にある。
articles.summary_zh: 软银集团（SBG）股价在11点5分时较前一日上涨507日元（14.91%），涨至3907日元，出现急剧反弹。 背景是前一日美国股市中由主要半导体相关股票构成的费城半导体指数（SOX）上涨了近7%，且其旗下企业相关动向也受到关注。

articles.headline: オリックス株価一時6.8%安 キオクシアHD株安で業績鈍化意識
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: オリックスの株価は9時40分時点で前日比378円（6.82%）安の5160円と大幅に反落し、4月下旬以来の安値を付けた。 9日に発表した2026年4〜9月期の連結決算（米国会計基準）で純利益が前年同期比3倍強の8562億円だった一方、投資先のキオクシアHDなどの株安が意識された。
articles.summary_zh: 欧力士股价在9点40分时较前一日下跌378日元（6.82%），跌至5160日元，大幅回落并创下4月下旬以来的低位。 该公司于9日公布的2026财年4至9月期合并财报（美国会计准则）显示净利润为8562亿日元，同比增加3倍以上，与此同时，投资对象铠侠控股等股票下跌的情况也受到市场意识。

articles.headline: 日経平均株価、一時6万円を回復 米AI株上昇や原油安で
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 10日の東京株式市場で日経平均株価は続伸で始まり、一時前日比で1800円超上げて節目の6万円を回復した。 前日の米株式市場でのAI関連銘柄の持ち直しや、原油先物相場の大幅安が投資家心理を下支えした。 アドバンテストやキオクシアホールディングスなど半導体関連株を中心に見直し買いが入った一方、米中間選挙前の水準には回復しておらず、市場では不透明感を指摘する声も出ている。
articles.summary_zh: 10日的东京股票市场上，日经平均指数连续上涨开盘，盘中一度较前一日上涨超过1800日元，重新收复6万日元关口。 前一日美国股市中人工智能相关股票的回稳以及原油期货行情的大幅下跌，对投资者心理起到了支撑作用。 以爱德万测试和铠侠控股等半导体相关股票为中心出现了回购买盘，另一方面，该指数尚未恢复至美国中期选举前的水平，市场中也有声音指出环境仍存在不确定性。

articles.headline: Taiwan Stocks Surge Nearly 2,000 Points but Foreign Investors Still Flee; Taiwan's Central Bank Confirms Over $10 Billion in Outflows in November
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: On the 9th, Taiwan's weighted index soared 1,960 points to close at 41,661 points with the National Stabilization Fund's 10th round of support and short-selling restrictions. Meanwhile, the three major institutional investors sold a net NT$94.526 billion (approximately $2.9 billion), with foreign investors selling NT$90.056 billion (approximately $2.7 billion) for their eighth consecutive session. Taiwan's Central Bank Governor Yang Chin-long confirmed on the 10th that November net foreign outflows exceeded $10 billion, while Premier Cho Jung-tai and Financial Supervisory Commission Chairman Peng Jin-lung emphasized Taiwan's economic resilience and fundamental strength. The Taiwan dollar fell to an intraday low of NT$32.957 before closing at NT$32.882.
articles.summary_zh: 9日，在国家安定基金启动第10轮市场支持以及金管会限制融券措施同时生效的背景下，台湾加权指数大涨1960点，收在41661点。 与此同时，三大法人合计净卖出945.26亿元新台币（约合29亿美元），其中外资单独减持900.56亿元新台币（约合27亿美元），连续第八个交易日撤资。 台湾央行行长杨金龙于10日在立法院证实，11月以来外资净流出已超过100亿美元，而行政院长卓荣泰与金管会主委彭金龙则强调了台湾的经济韧性与基本面实力。 新台币汇率盘中一度触及32.957元新台币的低点，最终收在32.882元新台币。

articles.headline: Gold Price Analysis Today | Forex Gold Analysis | XAU/USD Analysis - November 10, 2026
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) traded around $4,128 on November 10, 2026, after rising 1.70% to $4,140, supported by a weaker dollar index at 101.88 and falling crude oil prices. Markets awaited the U. S. October CPI report, with Natixis analyst Christopher Hodge expecting slower inflation alongside headline CPI up 0.29% and core CPI up 0.22%. Strong October nonfarm payrolls—adding 165,000 jobs with an 84,000-job upward revision—pushed the probability of a December Fed rate hike to 82.2%. Technical analysis showed gold testing the $4,145–4,157 resistance zone with the 1-hour RSI at 58, while structural support stemmed from U. S. debt concerns exceeding $40 trillion.
articles.summary_zh: 2026年11月10日，黄金（XAU/USD）交投于4128美元附近，此前曾因美元指数走弱至101.88以及原油价格下跌而上涨1.70%至4140美元。 市场正等待美国10月CPI报告，外贸银行（Natixis）的克里斯托弗·霍奇预计通胀将如预期般放缓，整体CPI将上涨0.29%，核心CPI将上涨0.22%。 10月非农就业人口强劲增加165,000人，且前值获向上修正84,000人，这使得美联储在12月加息的概率升至82.2%。 技术分析显示黄金正在测试4145至4157美元的阻力区，1小时RSI指标处于58，而超过$40 trillion的美国债务担忧则构成了结构性支撑。

articles.headline: Gold Holds Near $4,130 an Ounce as Oil Falls, Dollar Weakens
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: International gold prices traded firm near $4,130 an ounce on November 9, supported by falling oil prices and a weaker dollar amid hopes for an end to the war in the Middle East. Spot gold rose 1.7% the previous day and gained 5% last week following easing inflation concerns and peace talk prospects between the US and Iran. Brent crude fell to around $92 a barrel, while Bloomberg's dollar spot index dropped 0.5%. However, further gains were limited by expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December, with Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin and Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee noting a resilient US economy and persistent inflation. MKS PAMP head of metals strategy Nicky Shiels stated that the gold market will likely post modest gains or move sideways through year-end, with major institutional investors sidelined until January and short-term moves driven by trend-following trades and physical demand. At 8:27 a. m. Singapore time, spot gold was down 0.3% at $4,127.80 an ounce, and silver fell 0.3% to $53.30 an ounce.
articles.summary_zh: 国际黄金价格在11月9日持稳于每盎司约$4,130美元，受油价下跌和美元走软支撑，市场对中东战争结束抱有希望。 现货黄金前一日上涨1.7%，上周上涨5%，此前美国与伊朗和平谈判出现进展前景缓解了通货膨胀担忧。 布伦特原油跌至每桶约$92美元，彭博美元现货指数前一日下跌0.5%。 不过，美联储12月加息的预期限制了金价进一步上涨，里士满联邦储备银行行长汤姆·巴尔金和芝加哥联邦储备银行行长奥斯坦·古尔斯比均提及美国经济韧性和持续的通胀压力。 MKS PAMP金属策略主管尼基·希尔斯表示，金价在年底前可能小幅上涨或横盘整理，大型机构投资者可能将观望至1月，短期价格走势主要由顺势交易和实物需求驱动。 新加坡时间上午8时27分，现货黄金下跌0.3%至每盎司$4,127.80美元，白银下跌0.3%至每盎司$53.30美元。

articles.headline: US Dollar crashes today: Why is USD down against other currencies?
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The US dollar weakened against major currencies including the euro and the Japanese yen on Monday. The euro rose 0.64 per cent against the dollar to $1.1213, while the dollar declined 0.41 per cent against the yen to 157.89. Sterling increased 0.60 per cent to $1.34290, and the dollar index dipped 0.47 per cent to 101.75. In bond markets, the 10-year Treasury yield inched up to 4.87 per cent from 4.86 per cent late Friday following relative stability after big moves the previous week. Falling oil prices helped ease inflation worries that have affected global economies throughout the year.
articles.summary_zh: 周一，美元兑欧元和日元等主要货币走弱。 欧元兑美元上涨0.64%至$1.1213，美元兑日元下跌0.41%至157.89。 英镑上涨0.60%至$1.34290，衡量美元兑六种主要货币汇率的美元指数下跌0.47%至101.75。 在债券市场，继上周的大幅波动后，国债收益率保持相对稳定，10年期美国国债收益率从上周五晚些时候的4.86%微升至4.87%。 油价下跌有助于缓解全年困扰全球经济的通货膨胀担忧。

articles.headline: Bloomberg’s Top Yen Forecaster Sees Dollar-Yen Falling to 147 Next Year
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: TTT Moneycorp head of economics and market strategy Neil Parker stated that the dollar-yen exchange rate will fall to 147 yen next year, signaling yen strength driven by a narrowing US-Japan interest-rate gap. Parker expects the Bank of Japan to lift its policy rate from 1.25% to at least 2%, or potentially 2.25%, while seeing the Federal Reserve deliver one additional rate increase in December before holding its rate in a 4.00% to 4.25% range. Japan's consumer price index excluding fresh food and energy rose 2.4% in September from a year earlier, and Parker noted the BOJ could turn more aggressive if that measure exceeds 2.6%. He advised that investors only need to make a partial adjustment to their low exposure to the yen and Japanese assets. Meanwhile, foreign-exchange market forecasts remain sharply divided, with another strategist suggesting the rate could rise to 170 next year following an average of about 158 this year and a peak of 163.99 in July. Parker emphasized focusing on macroeconomic indicators such as interest rates and inflation rather than short-term swings.
articles.summary_zh: TTT Moneycorp经济与市场策略主管尼尔·帕克表示，明年美元兑日元汇率将跌至147日元，美日利差缩小将推动日元走强。 帕克预计日本银行将把政策利率从1.25%上调至至少2%，甚至可能达到2.25%，同时预计美联储在12月再加息一次，随后将基准利率维持在4.00%至4.25%区间。 日本9月剔除生鲜食品和能源后的消费价格指数同比上涨2.4%，帕克指出若该指标超过2.6%，日本银行可能会采取更激进的举措。 他认为投资者只需对日元和日本资产的低持仓进行部分调整。 与此同时，外汇市场预测仍存在严重分歧，另一位策略师暗示今年平均汇率约158且7月曾触及163.999高点后，明年该汇率可能升至170。

articles.headline: Bitcoin and Gold Have Never Been the Two Worst Major Assets in the Same Year Until 2026. Why Are Both Store-of-Value Assets Falling?
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Bitcoin and gold are the two worst-performing major assets of 2026, according to market analyst Charlie Bilello, who wrote on X on November 7, 2026, that Bitcoin is down 13% and gold is down 6%. Bitcoin traded at $75,034, down 1.2% over 24 hours and 14.3% for the year, closing at $74,740 on November 8, which is 40.5% below its October 6, 2025 all-time high of $126,080. Higher 10-year Treasury yields, which hit a 12-month high of 5.31% on October 5 and remained at 4.84% on November 5, along with a stronger dollar, drew money away from non-yielding assets. The Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund rose 7.8% this year through November 6. Speculative money flowed into AI stocks, which analyst Jordi Visser noted contrasted with Bitcoin's volatility of around 30. Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $1.28 billion in net outflows between November 2 and November 6. Gold traded at $4,056 on November 8, which is 26.5% below its January 28 peak of $5,518 following its 2025 rally. Bitcoin traded 5.3% below its 20-day average of $79,005 and 8.2% below its 50-day average of $81,760, but remained 2.5% above its 200-day average of $73,177. Ethereum dropped 4.6% to $2,134 and Solana slid 2.8% to $87. SPDR Gold Shares rose 1.3% early on November 9 and 6.1% over the week.
articles.summary_zh: 根据市场分析师查理·比莱洛于2026年11月7日在X上发布的信息，比特币和黄金是2026年表现最差的两大主要资产，比特币下跌13%，黄金下跌6%。 比特币交易价格为$75,034美元，24小时内下跌1.2%，年内下跌14.3%，11月8日收于$74,740美元，较2025年10月6日创下的$126,080美元历史高点低40.5%。 10年期国债收益率在10月5日触及12个月高点5.31%并在11月5日保持在4.84%，加之美元走强，将资金从无息资产中吸走。 景顺DB美元指数看涨基金今年截至11月6日上涨7.8%。 投机资金流入人工智能股票，分析师乔迪·维瑟指出这与比特币约30的波动率形成了对比。 现货比特币ETF在11月2日至11月6日期间净流出$12.8亿美元。 黄金在11月8日的交易价格为$4,056美元，较2025年涨势后1月28日创下的$5,518美元峰值低26.5%。 比特币较其$79,005美元的20日均线低5.3%，较其$81,760美元的50日均线低8.2%，但仍比其$73,177美元的200日均线高2.5%。 以太坊下跌4.6%至$2,134美元，索拉纳下跌2.8%至$87美元。 SPDR黄金股份在11月9日早盘上涨1.3%，一周内上涨6.1%。

articles.headline: Bitcoin’s ‘Glory Days Are Over,’ Bloomberg Expert Says as Bulls Push Back
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Mike McGlone stated on The Wolf Of All Streets podcast that Bitcoin's annualized volatility versus gold dropped to 1.1 to 1.2 times gold's volatility, signaling the end of its premium. McGlone pointed to a roughly $1 billion liquidation event Sunday that wiped out mostly long positions following $1.28 billion in spot Bitcoin ETF outflows last week that flipped funds negative for 2026, alongside reversals in commodities like gold, silver, platinum, palladium, lead, and natural gas. Conversely, Milk Road's Kyle Reidhead argued that Bitcoin's resilience through the Binance hack and Democratic midterm sweep indicates low remaining selling pressure, noting tailwinds from tokenization, agentic payments, and stablecoin growth. Academy Securities' Peter Tchir mentioned that economist Anna Wong does not expect a December rate hike despite prediction markets pricing 77% odds, with Tuesday's CPI data expected to decide the outcome, while Reidhead added that easing oil prices and cooling Treasury yields suggest a macro improvement. McGlone noted Bitcoin traded near $74,845, down 14% year to date while holding above February's 2026 low near $60,000, and stated a sustained 20% drawdown in the S&P 500 would confirm his bearish thesis. Reidhead expects Bitcoin to dip into the low $70,000s before finding support in an early-stage bull market.
articles.summary_zh: 彭博行业研究的迈克·麦格隆在《The Wolf Of All Streets》播客中表示，比特币相对黄金的年化波动率已降至黄金波动率的1.1至1.2倍，标志着其溢价的结束。 麦格隆指出，在上周现货比特币ETF流出$12.8亿美元导致资金在2026年转为负值之后，周日发生了约$10亿美元的清算事件，主要抹去了多头头寸，同时黄金、白金、钯金、铅和天然气等大宗商品也出现了反转。 相反，Milk Road的凯尔·里德黑德认为，比特币在币安黑客事件和民主党中期选举大胜中表现出的韧性表明市场上几乎没有剩余的卖盘，并指出了代币化、智能支付和稳定币增长带来的顺风。 Academy Securities的彼得·特希尔提到，尽管预测市场定价了77%的加息几率，但经济学家安娜·王预计12月不会加息，周二的CPI数据将决定结果，而里德黑德补充说，油价下跌和国债收益率冷却表明宏观背景正在改善。 麦格隆指出比特币交易价格接近$74,845美元，年内下跌14%，但保持在20世纪2026年2月近$60,000美元低点上方，并表示标普500指数持续下跌20%将证实其看空论点。 里德黑德预计比特币在牛市初期找到支撑之前会跌至$70,000美元低位。

articles.headline: Top-Ranked Yen Forecaster Sees Dollar Falling to 147 as BOJ Tightening Outpaces Fed
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Neil Parker, head of economics and market strategy at TTT Moneycorp Limited and Bloomberg's top-ranked dollar-yen forecaster, projects the Japanese yen will climb to about 147 per dollar next year. He expects the yen to reach roughly 155 by the end of this year before extending its advance. His call is based on the expectation that the Bank of Japan will tighten policy more aggressively than most investors anticipate, raising its benchmark rate from 1.25% to at least 2% or 2.25%. Meanwhile, he expects the Federal Reserve to deliver one more increase in December before pausing in a range of 4.00% to 4.25%. Parker points to underlying Japanese inflation, which rose 2.4% in September excluding fresh food and energy, noting that an acceleration to 2.6% or higher could provoke a firmer policy response. This widening policy divergence and a projected narrowing of the Japan-US rate differential underpin his currency outlook, contrasting with a divided market where other forecasters see the yen weakening significantly.
articles.summary_zh: 彭博社最新排名中准确度最高的美元兑日元预测师、TTT Moneycorp Limited经济与市场策略主管尼尔·帕克预测，明年日元兑美元汇率将攀升至约147。 他预计日元在今年年底前将达到约155，随后进一步上涨。 这一预测建立在他认为日本银行的紧缩政策将比多数投资者目前预期更为激进的看法之上，他预计日本银行将把基准利率从1.25%提升至至少2%或2.25%。 同时，他预计美联储在12月再进行一次加息后，将把利率暂停在4.00%至4.25%的区间。 帕克指出，日本9月份剔除鲜食和能源的核心消费者价格上涨了2.4%，并表示若加速至2.6%或更高可能会引发更坚决的政策反应。 这种不断缩小的日美利率差支撑了他的汇率观点，这与市场上其他预测日元将大幅走弱的观点形成了鲜明对比。
